detail.longDescription: I am trying to update one of my installed Python versions to its latest release using the Terminal. If I run py --list , I get all Python versions, that is 3.12 , 3.13 , and 3.14 . Python Manager py can update the most recent version 3.14 : py install --update but I can't figure out how to run py to update 3.13 or 3.12 to its latest release for bug fixes. Probably I will need to manually download and run installers, but is it possible using py ? EDIT. I forgot to mention, my OS is Windows 10 and I work on PowerShell. The default folder in PowerShell is D:\ . If I try to run py -V:3.13 install --update I am getting the following error: ...\Python313\python.exe: can't open file 'D:\\install': [Errno 2] No such file or directory BYW
